shared_or_similar_visual_information: A filled region selected by a comparison with a plotted boundary. On the left, use the gray side of the rising dashed line that contains the origin. On the right, use the hatched region below E and above the bottom of the curve labeled kx²/2.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It marks the open half-plane of coordinate pairs satisfying the strict linear inequality. Right image: Its horizontal footprint identifies where kx²/2 is below E, with equality at the two crossings.
Rationales: The shaded side identifies locations where the relevant comparison holds in each panel. The plotted boundary and its convention determine how equality is treated in each individual problem.
